title: Strato
summary: Raleigh names Strato in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Strato King of Zidon, whom Alexander Macedon threw out. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. II, sig. 233a–233b
